column1: # DsfRuleset fields (kind F). Each UnitType field is initialised inline with its own name,
# e.g. "private UnitType e = new UnitType(0, "General[i18n]: General", "GENERAL", ...)", so the
# name is not inferred - it is written in the declaration. The remaining names come from the
# getCargoUnits(int) indexes B, and the six String[][] template getters name C..H in order.
# "4x4" becomes fourByFour (a digit cannot start an identifier) and "Chinnook" keeps the games
# own spelling so the field still matches its "CHINNOOK" key.
# Left blank: the two FactionList fields b and c, which have no accessor of their own.
